graph_updates.title: KcsA: selectivity-filter geometry supports selective potassium conduction
graph_updates.description: Specific structural mechanism proposed for Streptomyces lividans KcsA in Doyle et al. (1998), PMID:9525859. Carbonyl geometry supports K+ coordination and discrimination against Na+. The source also proposes a multi-ion repulsion mechanism. These assertions do not describe every ion-channel selectivity filter.

SO:0000417.description: Selectivity-filter region in the KcsA structure studied by Doyle et al. (1998); no residue bounds or independent polypeptide-domain identity asserted.

GO:0046872.description: K+ coordination by backbone carbonyls in the studied KcsA selectivity filter.

GO:0005216.description: Selective potassium-channel function interpreted for the studied KcsA pore.
